record.what_it_does: MongoDB Atlas is a fully managed cloud database service, and its Atlas Administration API lets developers programmatically create and manage Atlas organizations, projects, clusters, users, and other administrative resources.
record.auth_notes: The Atlas Administration API supports two methods: (1) Service accounts using OAuth 2.0 client_credentials grant, which MongoDB now recommends, and (2) legacy API keys (public/private key pair) authenticated via HTTP Digest Authentication (not Basic or Bearer). Service account access tokens expire after 1 hour and cannot be refreshed, only regenerated.
record.access_notes: Any developer can create a free Atlas account and organization, then self-serve create service accounts or API keys directly from the Atlas UI/API with no vendor approval step. A free-tier (M0) cluster is available. Some IP access-list configuration is required before keys/tokens can be used.
record.main_blocker: Requires IP access-list configuration and, for org/project-scoped credentials, admin-level Atlas roles (Organization Owner / Project Owner) to provision service accounts or API keys.
